smell_validity.evidence: The diff genuinely turns Grammar into a god class: four labeled duty clusters (custom-callable wrapping, literal typing, token bookkeeping, decorator registry), each with its own state initialized in __init__, absorb helpers and force builders, decorator and metaclass to thread through one object; the lazy Grammar('') attach shows the artificial dependency. Slightly below reference quality because the token-type ledger has no consumer.

maintenance_impact.evidence: A change to any one duty (new literal form, callable convention, token introspection, decorator semantics) now requires reconstructing which _init_ call prepares the state and in what order inside the shared class, and edits aimed at one cluster can break the threaded builders. Removing the smell restores durable per-duty ownership; the burden is substantial but confined to the construction subsystem, not architecture-wide.

development_plausibility.evidence: Each step reads like ordinary evolution rooted in the project's own artifacts: the old code's XXX comment proposing the registry is answered, docstrings, error texts and the circular-import dodge survive verbatim, and duty accretion one PR at a time is believable. The symmetric four-cluster framing and the token ledger collected without any reader are faintly task-shaped, keeping it short of seamless authenticity.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt decisively prevents costly failure modes: it enumerates all four duties, forbids merely relocating the cluster to another single owner, demands each duty get a scoped owner, and a seven-point compatibility contract pins every observable (mixed-literal message, arity RuntimeError at construction, staticmethod/shared callables, first-by-line default rule, subclass override, bare RuleVisitor, public names). It materially reduces wrong direction, partial cleanup and redesign risk while leaving implementation free.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four purposes each need a different code-supported decision: per-callable cached classification (object identity/reuse), an accumulate-then-refuse literal record shared across one construction (ordering), token-type collection plus construction-time regex refusal (exception timing), and a class-level registry with source-line ordering consumed by the metaclass. Identical edits cannot serve all four.

localization_burden.evidence: Deciding repairs combines components: nodes.py decorator registration and metaclass assembly both read grammar.py's registry, Bootstrapstrapping grammar threads itself into literal construction, and detached visitors lazily create a blank Grammar. Plausible decoys must be excluded, such as is_callable (still exported) and the base RuleVisitor's real regex handling.

repair_coordination.evidence: Interacting shared rules: literal-record lifetime spans every construction site (reset per visit and mixed byte/str detection dies); tag_rule_method and from_rule_methods are a registered pair whose keying both decorator and metaclass depend on; the three _init_ registries must exist before wrapping and rule resolution. One-sided edits leave KeyError or silently permissive grammars.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: A uniform restore-the-deleted-helpers move fails everywhere: the factory needs a per-grammar cache and grammar closure, the literal record needs construction-long mutable state, the registry is class-scoped and metaclass-consumed, and the token path needs ordered refusal. Template-extracting each cluster still demands per-cluster lifetime and state decisions, so no single rule covers even 20%.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Specific wrong repairs compile and pass ordinary grammars but fail only in special state: a per-visit literal record silently accepts byte/str mixing that must raise; registry keying mistakes strand subclass overrides of decorated methods without touching common cases. Ordinary calls succeed, so failures surface late; the case files show no test evidence establishing unchecked paths for a higher score.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
